name: Internal controller decision memorandum

patterns_used: Use restrained one-page structure for a board decision or approved handoff endpoint.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only the restrained decision-and-handoff pattern inside the executive conclusion; create the analysis, appendices, facts, and language from the authorized new world.

purpose: Document a multi-issue accounting recommendation, evidence basis, risks, and unresolved support before approval.
medium: Native Word working memorandum with appendices

authority.governing_scope: Documents management's recommendation and its cited evidence basis.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not manufacture approval or supersede cited policies and executed records.

authorized_inputs: Documented management assumptions and open items
excluded_inputs: Prior answers and private evaluation material
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: Cited governing sources control; conflicts and missing support remain identified rather than silently resolved.

natural_depth: Unresolved questions, ownership, and attachment index
footprint.source_owned_rationale: Length follows the number of supported issues, alternatives, citations, appendices, and review items owned by the controller workflow.

sequence: Controller reviews conclusions and open items

features: Two or three terse review comments

prohibited: Margin notes that supply the conclusion

proof_gates.procedure: Check every conclusion, required action, citation, and appendix reference.
Render and inspect every page, appendix, header, footer, and comment anchor.
Inspect document properties, revisions, comments, custom XML, and embedded links.
Confirm no material calculations are delegated to this narrative template.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: Material computations belong in cited supporting schedules, not the memorandum template.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace every cited fact and attachment to the approved fictional-world manifest.
Scan body, appendices, comments, revisions, and metadata for prohibited residue.
Verify recommendation, approval, governing policy, and open questions remain distinct.
Map each section and appendix to an issue, source, decision, or review need.
